gtin.description: GS1 GTIN (8, 12, 13 or 14 digits) with a valid mod-10 check digit; variable measure GTINs (indicator digit 9) are refused. Answered normalised to 14 digits. One GTIN identifies one item or pack level.

packaging.description: Every pack level ever declared, lowest level first (retired ones have active false). Omitted when the item has none.

404.description: not-found (ErrNotFound): an unknown catalogItemId or feedId.

type.description: Problem type slug: the shared not-found, illegal-transition, concurrent-update and validation-failed, or one of this context's (invalid-item-dimensions, invalid-gtin, gtin-already-assigned, pack-quantity-immutable, pack-level-order, invalid-pack-quantity, invalid-pack-dimensions, invalid-pack-level, pack-level-not-found, negative-availability, stale-availability, node-not-sellable, duplicate-listing, listing-not-on-node, feed-already-applied).

409.description: gtin-already-assigned, pack-quantity-immutable, illegal-transition (the item is DISCONTINUED) or concurrent-update after one automatic retry.
